metadata.method: Release cells: 28-55 deg slopes on the portal DEM (Copernicus GLO-30 zoom 12, ~30 m) within the search radius; sliding block with Voellmy-type friction (mu 0.20, xi*h 4000 m/s2, textbook defaults, not calibrated). impact = released at the highest ground above the documented place (a peak within 4 km) and run down its own fall line; place_dist_m says how close it comes to the place; band = release at the elevation given in the record. Illustrative: not the historical path.
